group: Group 2: 传染病+气象 简化版

tasks.question: What is the mean number of cases recorded across all countries and years?
tasks.constraints: Calculate the mean of the column 'No. of cases'. Convert the data in 'No. of cases' from string form to numeric form before calculation. Ignore rows where 'No. of cases' is null or empty. Report the result rounded to two decimal places.
tasks.answer_format: @mean_cases[mean_value] where "mean_value" is a positive number rounded to two decimal places.

tasks.question: What is the percentage of missing values in the "No. of cases_min" column? How does this percentage compare to the percentage of missing values in the "No. of deaths_max" column?
tasks.constraints: Calculate the percentage of missing values for both "No. of cases_min" and "No. of deaths_max". Report both percentages rounded to two decimal places.
tasks.answer_format: @percentage_cases_min[percentage] @percentage_deaths_max[percentage] where each "percentage" is a number between 0 and 100 rounded to two decimal places.

tasks.question: Which country has the highest number of deaths recorded in a single year?
tasks.constraints: Calculate the maximum value in the 'No. of deaths' column. Convert 'No. of deaths' from string form to numeric form before calculation. Ignore rows where 'No. of deaths' is null or empty. Return the country and the year corresponding to the maximum value.
tasks.answer_format: @max_deaths_country[country_name] @max_deaths_year[year] where "country_name" is a country name string and "year" is an integer year.

memory.note: 找 deaths 最大值对应的国家和年份

tasks.question: What is the Pearson correlation coefficient between the number of cases and the number of deaths recorded?
tasks.constraints: Calculate the Pearson correlation coefficient between 'No. of cases' and 'No. of deaths'. Convert both columns from string form to numeric form before calculation. Use only rows where both values are present. Round the result to two decimal places.
tasks.answer_format: @correlation_coefficient[r_value] where "r_value" is a number between -1 and 1 rounded to two decimal places.

memory.note: cases 和 deaths 的整体相关系数

tasks.question: Among the countries whose "WHO Region" value is exactly "Americas", which country has the highest average number of cases recorded over the years?
tasks.constraints: Use the values in the "WHO Region" column exactly as they appear in the CSV, even if they look unusual. For rows whose "WHO Region" is "Americas", calculate the average of "No. of cases" for each country. Convert "No. of cases" to numeric form before calculation and ignore rows where it is missing.
tasks.answer_format: @country_name[country] where "country" is the country name string with the highest average number of cases among rows whose "WHO Region" is "Americas".

memory.note: 按 WHO Region 过滤后按国家求平均 cases

tasks.question: What is the mean wind speed in the dataset?
tasks.constraints: Calculate the arithmetic mean of WINDSPEED, excluding null values. Report the answer to three decimal places.
tasks.answer_format: @mean_windspeed[mean_windspeed] where "mean_windspeed" is a number rounded to three decimal places.

tasks.question: What is the average wind speed in January (month 1)?
tasks.constraints: The "DATE TIME" column in this CSV is in month/day/year form such as "01/01/2015 00:00". Treat the first component as the month. Use only rows from month 1, ignore missing WINDSPEED values, and report the average wind speed rounded to two decimal places.
tasks.answer_format: @avg_windspeed_month_1[avg_value] where "avg_value" is the average WINDSPEED for month 1 rounded to two decimal places.

memory.note: 轻量日期解析 + 按月过滤

tasks.question: Is the distribution of wind speeds (WINDSPEED) normally distributed?
tasks.constraints: Use the Shapiro-Wilk test to judge normality. If the p-value is greater than 0.05, answer "yes". Otherwise answer "no". Ignore missing WINDSPEED values.
tasks.answer_format: @normal_distribution[yes/no] where the value is "yes" if the distribution is normal and "no" otherwise.

tasks.question: How many missing values are there in the WINDSPEED, AT, and RELHUM columns?
tasks.constraints: Count missing values separately for the columns WINDSPEED, AT, and RELHUM. Treat empty cells as missing.
tasks.answer_format: @missing_windspeed[count] @missing_at[count] @missing_relhum[count] where each "count" is a non-negative integer.

tasks.question: Are there any outliers in the atmospheric pressure column (BARO)? If yes, how many outliers are there?
tasks.constraints: An outlier is any BARO value that is more than 1.5 times the interquartile range above the third quartile or below the first quartile. Ignore null values.
tasks.answer_format: @number_of_outliers[number_of_outliers] where "number_of_outliers" is the total number of detected outliers as an integer.

memory.note: BARO 列 IQR 异常值个数

tasks.question: Using only rows where wind direction (DIR) is equal to 180, what is the Pearson correlation coefficient between WINDSPEED and BARO?
tasks.constraints: Filter the dataset to rows where DIR equals 180. Then calculate the Pearson correlation coefficient between WINDSPEED and BARO using only rows where both values are present. Round the result to two decimal places.
tasks.answer_format: @correlation_coefficient[r_value] where "r_value" is a number between -1 and 1 rounded to two decimal places.

memory.note: 条件过滤后的相关系数

tasks.question: What are the mean wind speeds before and after replacing outlier wind speeds?
tasks.constraints: Use the Z-score method with threshold 3.0 on WINDSPEED. First calculate the mean wind speed before preprocessing. Then replace any WINDSPEED value whose absolute Z-score is greater than 3 with the original mean wind speed. After replacement, calculate the mean wind speed again. Ignore missing WINDSPEED values. Report both means rounded to two decimal places.
tasks.answer_format: @mean_wind_pre[mean_wind_pre] @mean_wind_post[mean_wind_post] where both values are rounded to two decimal places.

memory.note: 轻量预处理：仅保留 wind speed 去异常值前后均值
